a: A carried line's pen reach is ignored by the clip test, so a stroked line passes `insideClips` while its ink leaves the clip
`textObject` ignores a run's `lang`, so language-specific forms are lost without the box being rasterized
b: Carried `.lbx` objects skip the auto-length bound every mapped object is held to
`rasterDpi` is never validated, so 0, a negative or NaN writes non-finite image positions into the file
